units.zh: 天文上
units.en: Astronomy 1
units.literal: Astronomy, Part One

units.zh: 《易》曰：「聖人仰觀象於天，俯觀法於地。」
units.en: The Changes says: "The sage looked up to read Heaven's patterns and looked down to learn Earth's forms."
units.literal: The Book of Changes says: "The sage looked up to observe patterns in Heaven and looked down to observe models on Earth."

units.zh: 天文之事，其來已久。
units.en: The study of heaven goes back a very long way.
units.literal: Matters of astronomy have a history stretching far back.

units.zh: 太祖革命受終，膺集期運。
units.en: When the Grand Ancestor rose by revolution and received the transfer of power, he grasped the fortune of the age.
units.literal: The Grand Ancestor received the mandate through revolution and accepted the transfer of the throne, taking upon himself the destined fortune of the age.

units.zh: 宋昇明三年，太史令將作匠文孝建陳天文，奏曰：「自孝建元年至昇明三年，日蝕有十，虧上有七。
units.en: In Song's third Shengming year, Wen Xiaojian—Director of Astronomy and Master of Works—reported celestial omens and memorialized: "From Xiaojian 1 through Shengming 3 there were ten solar eclipses, seven with the sun obscured at the top.
units.literal: In the third year of Shengming of Song, Wen Xiaojian, Director of Astronomy and Master of Works, presented a report on celestial phenomena and memorialized: "From the first year of Xiaojian to the third year of Shengming, solar eclipses numbered ten, with upper obscuration in seven.

units.zh: 占曰『有亡國失君之象』。
units.en: The omen-reading says, 『This points to a ruined kingdom and a fallen ruler.』
units.literal: Prognostication says 『there is an image of a perished state and a lost ruler』.

units.zh: 一曰『國命絕，主危亡』。
units.en: Another gloss reads, 『The dynastic line is broken; the sovereign is in mortal danger.』
units.literal: One reading says 『the state's mandate is cut off; the ruler faces peril and extinction』.

units.zh: 孝建元年至昇明三年，太白經天五。
units.en: From Xiaojian 1 to Shengming 3, Venus crossed the meridian in daylight five times.
units.literal: From the first year of Xiaojian to the third year of Shengming, Venus crossed heaven five times.

units.zh: 占曰『天下革，民更王，異姓興』。
units.en: The reading is, 『The realm will be overturned, the people will change kings, and a new house will rise.』
units.literal: Prognostication says 『the realm is transformed; the people change their king; another surname rises』.

units.zh: 孝建元年至昇明三年，月犯房心四，太白犯房心五。
units.en: In the same span the Moon infringed on the Room and Heart mansions four times and Venus did so five times.
units.literal: From the first year of Xiaojian to the third year of Shengming, the Moon transgressed Fang and Xin four times; Venus transgressed Fang and Xin five times.

units.zh: 占曰『其國有喪，宋當之』。
units.en: The omen says, 『The realm will mourn—and Song will be the one.』
units.literal: Prognostication says 『that state will have mourning; Song will bear it』.

units.zh: 孝建元年至永光元年，奔星出入紫宮有四。
units.en: From Xiaojian 1 through Yongguang 1, four shooting stars appeared entering and leaving the Purple Palace.
units.literal: From the first year of Xiaojian to the first year of Yongguang, shooting stars entering and leaving the Purple Palace numbered four.

units.zh: 占曰『國去其君，有空國徙王』。
units.en: The reading is, 『The kingdom loses its lord; the throne sits empty and a ruler is driven abroad.』
units.literal: Prognostication says 『the state loses its ruler; there is an empty state and a relocated king』.

units.zh: 大明二年至元徽四年，天再裂。
units.en: From Daming 2 through Yuanhui 4, the sky appeared to split twice.
units.literal: From the second year of Daming to the fourth year of Yuanhui, Heaven split twice.

units.zh: 占曰『陽不足，白虹貫日，人君惡之』。
units.en: The gloss runs, 『Yang is insufficient—a white rainbow pierces the sun—and the sovereign is marked for misfortune.』
units.literal: Prognostication says 『yang is insufficient; a white rainbow pierces the sun; the ruler is ill-omened』.

units.zh: 孝建二年至大明五年，月入太微。
units.en: From Xiaojian 2 to Daming 5, the Moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
units.literal: From the second year of Xiaojian to the fifth year of Daming, the Moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

units.zh: 泰豫元年至昇明三年，月又入太微。
units.en: From Taiyu 1 through Shengming 3, the Moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure again.
units.literal: From the first year of Taiyu to the third year of Shengming, the Moon again entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

units.zh: 孝建元年至元徽二年，太白入太微各八，熒惑入太微六。
units.en: From Xiaojian 1 to Yuanhui 2, Venus entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure eight times and Mars did so six times.
units.literal: From the first year of Xiaojian to the second year of Yuanhui, Venus entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure eight times; Mars entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure six times.

units.zh: 占曰『七耀行不軌道，危亡之象。
units.en: The omen reads, 『The seven luminaries leave their proper courses—a sign of ruin and death.
units.literal: Prognostication says 『the seven luminaries move off their proper paths—a sign of peril and extinction.

units.zh: 貴人失權勢，主亦衰，當有王入爲主』。
units.en: The great lose their standing, the sovereign weakens, and a new king will rise to rule』.
units.literal: Nobles lose power and rank; the ruler also declines; a king will enter and become master』.

units.zh: 孝建二年至昇明二年，太白熒惑經羽林各三。
units.en: From Xiaojian 2 to Shengming 2, Venus and Mars each crossed the Feathered Forest asterism three times.
units.literal: From the second year of Xiaojian to the second year of Shengming, Venus and Mars each passed through the Feathered Forest three times.

units.zh: 占曰『國殘更世』。
units.en: The reading is, 『The kingdom is broken and the dynasty turns over.』
units.literal: Prognostication says 『the state is maimed and the age changes』.

units.zh: 孝建二年四月十三日，熒惑守南斗，成勾己。
units.en: On Xiaojian 2, fourth month, day 13, Mars held the Southern Dipper and formed a gouji hook configuration.
units.literal: On the thirteenth day of the fourth month of the second year of Xiaojian, Mars stationed at the Southern Dipper, forming a gouji hook.

units.zh: 占曰『天下易正更元』。
units.en: The omen says, 『The realm will change its ruling house and inaugurate a new reign era.』
units.literal: Prognostication says 『the realm changes its orthodoxy and begins a new era』.

units.zh: 孝建三年十二月一日，填星熒惑辰星合于南斗。
units.en: On Xiaojian 3, twelfth month, day 1, Saturn, Mars, and Mercury gathered in the Southern Dipper.
units.literal: On the first day of the twelfth month of the third year of Xiaojian, Saturn, Mars, and Mercury conjoined at the Southern Dipper.

units.zh: 占曰『改立王公』。
units.en: The reading is, 『Princes and dukes will be removed and replaced.』
units.literal: Prognostication says 『princes and dukes are deposed and established anew』.

units.zh: 大明二年十二月二十六日，太白犯填星于斗。
units.en: On Daming 2, twelfth month, day 26, Venus infringed on Saturn in the Dipper.
units.literal: On the twenty-sixth day of the twelfth month of the second year of Daming, Venus transgressed Saturn in the Dipper.

units.zh: 六年十一月十五日，太白填星合于危。
units.en: On the sixth year, eleventh month, day 15, Venus and Saturn gathered in the Wei mansion.
units.literal: On the fifteenth day of the eleventh month of the sixth year, Venus and Saturn conjoined in Wei.

units.zh: 占曰『天子失土』。
units.en: The omen says, 『The Son of Heaven will lose his lands.』
units.literal: Prognostication says 『the Son of Heaven loses his territory』.

units.zh: 景和元年十月八日，熒惑守太微，成勾己。
units.en: On Jinghe 1, tenth month, day 8, Mars held the Supreme Palace Enclosure and formed a gouji hook configuration.
units.literal: On the eighth day of the tenth month of the first year of Jinghe, Mars stationed at the Supreme Palace Enclosure, forming a gouji hook.

units.zh: 占曰『王者惡之，主命無期，有徙主，若主王，天下更紀』。
units.en: The reading runs, 『Kings take it as ill-omened; the sovereign's allotted fate has no set term; a ruler is displaced; one may become king in his stead; the realm changes its dynastic reckoning.』
units.literal: Prognostication says 『kings find it ominous; the ruler's lifespan is uncertain; there is a displaced sovereign; perhaps one becomes lord-king; the realm changes its era reckoning』.

units.zh: 泰始三年正月十七日，白氣見西南，東西半天，名曰長庚。
units.en: On the third year of Taishi, first month, day 17, white vapor showed in the southwest, stretching east to west across half the sky; it was named Changgeng.
units.literal: On the seventeenth day of the first month of the third year of Taishi, white vapor appeared in the southwest, spanning half the sky east to west; it was called Changgeng.

units.zh: 六年九月二十七日，白氣又見東南長二丈，竝形狀長大，猛過彗星。
units.en: On the sixth year, ninth month, day 27, white vapor appeared again in the southeast, two zhang in length; both were large and long in form, fiercer than a comet.
units.literal: On the twenty-seventh day of the ninth month of the sixth year, white vapor appeared again in the southeast, two zhang long; both in shape were large and long, surpassing a comet in fierceness.

units.zh: 占曰『除舊布新易主之象，遠期一紀』。
units.en: The omen says, 『A sign of sweeping out the old and raising the new—a change of master; the distant term is one twelve-year cycle.』
units.literal: Prognostication says 『an image of removing the old and spreading the new—changing masters; the distant term is one cycle』.

units.zh: 至昇明三年，一紀訖。
units.en: By Shengming 3, the twelve-year cycle had run its course.
units.literal: By the third year of Shengming, one cycle was complete.

units.zh: 泰始四年四月二十四日，太白犯填星于胃。
units.en: On the fourth year of Taishi, fourth month, day 24, Venus infringed on Saturn in the Stomach mansion.
units.literal: On the twenty-fourth day of the fourth month of the fourth year of Taishi, Venus transgressed Saturn in Stomach.

units.zh: 占曰『主命惡之』。
units.en: The reading is, 『The sovereign's life is marked for misfortune.』
units.literal: Prognostication says 『the ruler's lifespan is ill-omened』.

units.zh: 泰始七年六月十七日，太白歲星填星合于東井。
units.en: On the seventh year of Taishi, sixth month, day 17, Venus, Jupiter, and Saturn gathered in the Eastern Well.
units.literal: On the seventeenth day of the sixth month of the seventh year of Taishi, Venus, Jupiter, and Saturn conjoined at the Eastern Well.

units.zh: 占曰『改立王公』。
units.en: The reading is, 『Princes and dukes will be removed and replaced.』
units.literal: Prognostication says 『princes and dukes are deposed and established anew』.

units.zh: 元徽四年至昇明二年三月，日有頻食。
units.en: From Yuanhui 4 through the third month of Shengming 2, solar eclipses came in quick succession.
units.literal: From the fourth year of Yuanhui to the third month of the second year of Shengming, the sun had frequent eclipses.

units.zh: 占曰『社稷將亡，王者惡之』。
units.en: The reading is, 『The altars of state face ruin—and kings take it as ill-omened.』
units.literal: Prognostication says 『the altars of state are about to perish; kings find it ominous』.

units.zh: 元徽四年十月十日，填星守太微宮，逆從行，歷四年。
units.en: On Yuanhui 4, tenth month, day 10, Saturn held the Supreme Palace Enclosure, moving retrograde and direct for four years.
units.literal: On the tenth day of the tenth month of the fourth year of Yuanhui, Saturn stationed at the Supreme Palace Enclosure, moving in reverse and direct motion, lasting four years.

units.zh: 占曰『有亡君之戒，易世立王』。
units.en: The omen says, 『There is warning of a fallen sovereign; the age turns and a new king is raised.』
units.literal: Prognostication says 『there is a warning of a perished ruler; the age changes and a king is established』.

units.zh: 元徽五年七月一日，熒惑太白辰星合于翼。
units.en: On Yuanhui 5, seventh month, day 1, Mars, Venus, and Mercury gathered in the Wings mansion.
units.literal: On the first day of the seventh month of the fifth year of Yuanhui, Mars, Venus, and Mercury conjoined in Wings.

units.zh: 占曰『改立王公』。
units.en: The reading is, 『Princes and dukes will be removed and replaced.』
units.literal: Prognostication says 『princes and dukes are deposed and established anew』.

units.zh: 昇明二年六月二十日，歲星守斗建。
units.en: On Shengming 2, sixth month, day 20, Jupiter held Dipper Establishment.
units.literal: On the twentieth day of the sixth month of the second year of Shengming, Jupiter stationed at Dipper Establishment.

units.zh: 陰陽終始之門，大赦昇平之所起，律歷七政之本源，德星守之，天下更年，五禮更興，多暴貴者。
units.en: Dipper Establishment is the gate where yin and yang turn over, where great amnesties and the rise of peace begin, and the root of pitch pipes, calendrics, and the seven luminaries; when the Virtue Star holds it, the realm changes its year-reckoning, the five rites are revived, and many are suddenly ennobled.
units.literal: The gate of yin-yang's end and beginning; where great amnesties and the ascension to peace arise; the root source of pitch pipes, calendars, and the seven regulators; when the Virtue Star holds it, the realm changes its year-count, the five rites are renewed, and many rise swiftly to high rank.

units.zh: 昇明二年十月一日，熒惑守輿鬼。
units.en: On Shengming 2, tenth month, day 1, Mars held the Chariot-and-Ghost asterism.
units.literal: On the first day of the tenth month of the second year of Shengming, Mars stationed at Chariot and Ghost.

units.zh: 三年正月七日，熒惑守兩戒閒，成勾己。
units.en: On the third year, first month, day 7, Mars held position between the two ecliptic boundaries and formed a gouji hook configuration.
units.literal: On the seventh day of the first month of the third year, Mars stationed between the two celestial boundaries, forming a gouji hook.

units.zh: 占曰『尊者失朝，必有亡國去王』。
units.en: The omen reads: "The great will fall from court; a state will perish and its king be lost."
units.literal: Prognostication reads: "The exalted will lose court; there will surely be a perished state and a departed king."

units.zh: 昇明三年正月十八日，辰星孟效西方。
units.en: Shengming 3, first month, eighteenth day: Mercury first appeared brightly in the west.
units.literal: Shengming the third year, first month, eighteenth day: Mercury made its first prominent appearance in the west.

units.zh: 占曰『天下更王』。
units.en: The omen reads: "The realm will change its king."
units.literal: Prognostication reads: "The realm will change its king."

units.zh: 昇明三年四月，歲星在虛危，徘徊玄枵之野，則齊國有福厚，爲受慶之符。」
units.en: Shengming 3, fourth month: Jupiter stood in Xu and Wei, circling the Xuanxiao quarter—an omen that Qi would receive great fortune and abundant blessing."
units.literal: Shengming year 3, fourth month: Jupiter was in Xu and Wei, lingering in the wilderness of Xuanxiao—thus Qi would enjoy deep blessing, a sign of receiving felicitation."

units.zh: 今所記三辰七曜之變，起建元訖于隆昌，以續宋史。
units.en: The celestial changes recorded below run from Jianyuan through Longchang, continuing the Song History.
units.literal: What is now recorded of the changes of the three luminaries and seven regulators begins at Jianyuan and runs to Longchang, continuing the Song History.

units.zh: 建武世太史奏事，明帝不欲使天變外傳，竝祕而不出，自此闕焉。
units.en: Under Jianwu the court astrologer's reports were suppressed: Emperor Ming would not let heavenly portents leak out, and from then on the record breaks off.
units.literal: In the Jianwu era the Grand Astrologer's reports—Emperor Ming, not wishing heavenly anomalies to be spread abroad, kept them all secret and unpublished; hence the gap from that point.

units.zh: 建元二年九月甲午朔，日蝕。
units.en: In the second year of Jianyuan, ninth month, jiawu new moon: the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: the second year of Jianyuan, ninth month, jiawu new moon: there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 三年七月己未朔，日蝕。
units.en: In the third year, seventh month, jiwei new moon: the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the third year, seventh month, jiwei new moon: there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 永明元年十二月乙巳朔，日蝕。
units.en: Yongming 1, twelfth month, yisi new moon: the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: Yongming year 1, twelfth month, yisi new moon: there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 十年十二月癸未朔，加時在午之半度，到未初見日始蝕，虧起西北角，蝕十分之四，申時光色復還。
units.en: In the tenth year, twelfth month, guiwei new moon: the eclipse fell at mid-wu; as wei began the sun first darkened from the northwest; four-tenths of the disk was covered; by shen hour full light returned.
units.literal: In the tenth year, twelfth month, guiwei new moon: the appointed hour was at half a degree into wu; reaching the start of wei the sun began to be eclipsed; the bite began at the northwest corner; four-tenths was eclipsed; at shen hour light and color were restored.

units.zh: 隆昌元年五月甲戌合朔，巳時日蝕三分之一，午時光復還。
units.en: Longchang 1, fifth month, jiaxu new moon: at si hour one-third of the sun was eclipsed; by wu hour light had returned.
units.literal: Longchang year 1, fifth month, jiaxu conjunction at new moon: at si hour the sun was one-third eclipsed; at wu hour light was restored.

units.zh: 建元四年七月戊辰，月在危宿蝕。
units.en: In the fourth year of Jianyuan, seventh month, wuchen: the moon was eclipsed in the Wei asterism.
units.literal: Jianyuan year 4, seventh month, wuchen: the moon was eclipsed in the Wei asterism.

units.zh: 永明二年四月丁巳，月在南斗宿蝕。
units.en: Yongming 2, fourth month, dingsi: the moon was eclipsed in the Southern Dipper.
units.literal: Yongming the second year, fourth month, dingsi: the moon was eclipsed in the Southern Dipper asterism.

units.zh: 三年十一月戊寅，月入東井曠中，因蝕三分之一。
units.en: In the third year, eleventh month, wuyin: the moon entered the open field of the Eastern Well and was one-third eclipsed.
units.literal: In the third year, eleventh month, wuyin: the moon entered the open space of the Eastern Well and was eclipsed one-third.

units.zh: 五年三月庚子，月在氐宿蝕。
units.en: In the fifth year, third month, gengzi: the moon was eclipsed in the Di asterism.
units.literal: In the fifth year, third month, gengzi: the moon was eclipsed in the Di asterism.

units.zh: 九月戊戌，月在胃宿蝕。
units.en: Ninth month, wuxu: the moon was eclipsed in the Stomach asterism.
units.literal: Ninth month, wuxu: the moon was eclipsed in the Stomach asterism.

units.zh: 六年九月癸巳，月蝕在婁宿九度，加時在寅之少弱，虧起東北角，蝕十五分之十一。
units.en: In the sixth year, ninth month, guisi: the moon was eclipsed at the ninth degree of Lou; the shadow began at the northeast when yin was barely past; eleven-fifteenths of the disk was covered.
units.literal: In the sixth year, ninth month, guisi: lunar eclipse at the ninth degree of the Lou asterism; timed at slight weakness into yin; the bite began at the northeast corner; eleven-fifteenths was eclipsed.

units.zh: 十五日子時，蝕從東北始，至子時末都旣，到丑時光色還復。
units.en: On the fifteenth, at zi hour the shadow started in the northeast; by the end of zi the eclipse was total; by chou hour the moon's light had returned.
units.literal: On the fifteenth, at zi hour the eclipse began from the northeast; by the end of zi it was wholly complete; by chou hour light and color were restored.

units.zh: 七年八月丁亥，月在奎宿蝕。
units.en: In the seventh year, eighth month, dinghai: the moon was eclipsed in the Kui asterism.
units.literal: In the seventh year, eighth month, dinghai: the moon was eclipsed in the Kui asterism.

units.zh: 十月庚辰，月奄蝕熒惑。
units.en: Tenth month, gengchen: the moon occulted Mars.
units.literal: Tenth month, gengchen: the moon covered and eclipsed Mars.

units.zh: 八年六月庚寅，月奄蝕畢左股第一星。
units.en: In the eighth year, sixth month, gengyin: the moon occulted the first star of the left thigh of the Net asterism.
units.literal: In the eighth year, sixth month, gengyin: the moon covered and eclipsed the first star of the left thigh of Net.

units.zh: 十年十二月丁酉，月蝕在柳度，加時在酉之少弱，到亥時月蝕起東角七分之二，至子時光色還復。
units.en: In the tenth year, twelfth month, dingyou: the moon was eclipsed in Willow; the shadow began at you when the hour was barely past; at hai hour two-sevenths of the eastern rim was eaten; by zi hour the light had returned.
units.literal: In the tenth year, twelfth month, dingyou: lunar eclipse at the Willow degree; timed at slight weakness into you; reaching hai hour the eclipse began at two-sevenths from the east edge; by zi hour light and color were restored.

units.zh: 永泰元年四月癸亥，月蝕，色赤如血。
units.en: Yongtai 1, fourth month, guihai: the moon was eclipsed, its color red as blood.
units.literal: Yongtai year 1, fourth month, guihai: lunar eclipse; the color was red as blood.

units.zh: 三日而大司馬王敬則舉兵，衆以爲敬則祲烈所感。
units.en: Three days later Grand Marshal Wang Jingze rose in rebellion; many took it as a response to these violent omens.
units.literal: Three days later Grand Marshal Wang Jingze raised troops; the multitude held that Jingze had been moved by these ominous fierce portents.

units.zh: 永元元年八月己未，月蝕盡，色皆赤。
units.en: Yongyuan 1, eighth month, jiwei: the moon was totally eclipsed, glowing wholly red.
units.literal: Yongyuan year 1, eighth month, jiwei: the moon was wholly eclipsed; the color was all red.

units.zh: 是夜，始安王遙光伏誅。
units.en: That same night Prince of Shian Xiao Yaoguang was put to death.
units.literal: That night Prince of Shian Xiao Yaoguang was executed.

units.zh: 史臣曰：日月代照，實重天行。
units.en: The compiler remarks: Sun and moon take turns in giving light—a matter of grave importance in heaven's cycles.
units.literal: The historians say: Sun and moon alternate in shining—this truly weighs on the celestial motion.

units.zh: 上交下蝕，同度相掩。
units.en: The node lies above and the eclipse below; at the same degree they cover one another.
units.literal: Upper node, lower eclipse; same degree, mutually covering.

units.zh: 案舊說曰「日有五蝕」，謂起上下左右中央是也。
units.en: The old teaching holds that "the sun has five kinds of eclipse"—beginning from above, below, left, right, and the center.
units.literal: Examining the old doctrine: "The sun has five eclipses"—meaning starting from top, bottom, left, right, and center.

units.zh: 交會舊術，日蝕不從東始，以月從其西，東行及日。
units.en: By the old conjunction method, a solar eclipse never starts in the east: the moon approaches from the west, moves eastward, and meets the sun.
units.literal: The old method of node conjunction: solar eclipses do not begin from the east, for the moon comes from the west, travels east, and reaches the sun.

units.zh: 於交中，交從外入內者，先會後交，虧西南角；
units.en: At conjunction, if the node enters from without: first encounter then crossing, and the shadow bites the southwest corner;
units.literal: At the node, when the node enters from outside: encounter first then node-crossing, bite at the southwest corner;

units.zh: 先交後會，虧西北角；
units.en: crossing first then encounter, and the shadow bites the northwest corner;
units.literal: node-crossing first then encounter, bite at the northwest corner;

units.zh: 交從內出者，先會後交，虧西北角；
units.en: if the node exits from within: first encounter then crossing, and the shadow bites the northwest corner;
units.literal: when the node exits from inside: encounter first then node-crossing, bite at the northwest corner;

units.zh: 先交後會，虧西南角。
units.en: crossing first then encounter, and the shadow bites the southwest corner.
units.literal: node-crossing first then encounter, bite at the southwest corner.

units.zh: 日正在交中者，則虧於西，故不嘗蝕東也。
units.en: When the sun stands right at the node, the shadow falls on the west—so an eclipse never begins in the east.
units.literal: When the sun is directly at the node, the bite is on the west—thus it never eclipses from the east.

units.zh: 若日中有虧，名爲黑子，不名爲蝕也。
units.en: A blemish within the sun itself is called a black spot, not an eclipse.
units.literal: If there is a bite within the sun, it is called a black spot—not called an eclipse.

units.zh: 漢尚書令黃香曰：「日蝕皆從西，月蝕皆從東，無上下中央者。」
units.en: Huang Xiang, Director of the Masters of Writing under Han, said: "Solar eclipses always start in the west and lunar eclipses in the east; none begin from above, below, or the center."
units.literal: Han Director of the Masters of Writing Huang Xiang said: "Solar eclipses all begin from the west; lunar eclipses all begin from the east; there are none from top, bottom, or center."

units.zh: 《春秋》魯桓三年日蝕，貫中下上竟黑。
units.en: The Spring and Autumn Annals records a solar eclipse in Duke Huan of Lu's third year that cut through the center and left top and bottom wholly black.
units.literal: The Spring and Autumn Annals: Lu Huan year 3 solar eclipse—pierced middle, top and bottom, all turned black.

units.zh: 疑者以爲日月正等，月何得小而見日中。
units.en: Skeptics argued that if sun and moon are the same size, how could the smaller moon appear inside the sun?
units.literal: Doubters held that sun and moon are equal in size—how could the moon be small yet be seen within the sun?

units.zh: 鄭玄云：「月正掩日，日光從四邊出，故言從中起也。」
units.en: Zheng Xuan replied: "The moon was directly masking the sun, and light streamed out on every side—hence the report that the eclipse began at the center."
units.literal: Zheng Xuan said: "The moon was directly covering the sun; sunlight issued from all four sides—hence it is said to begin from the center."

units.zh: 王逸以爲「月若掩日，當蝕日西，月行旣疾，須臾應過西崖旣，復次食東崖，今察日蝕西崖缺，而光已復過東崖而獨不掩」。
units.en: Wang Yi objected: "If the moon masked the sun, it ought to eat the western edge first; moving quickly, it should soon pass the western limb and then bite the eastern one. Yet we see the western rim darkened while light has already returned past the eastern rim, which alone remains uncovered."
units.literal: Wang Yi held: "If the moon covered the sun, it should eclipse the sun's west; the moon moves swiftly and in an instant should have passed the western rim, then again eaten the eastern rim—yet now we observe the sun's western rim is eaten, while light has already passed the eastern rim and that alone is not covered."

units.zh: 逸之此意，實爲巨疑。
units.en: Wang Yi's objection raises a serious difficulty.
units.literal: Wang Yi's point here is truly a great doubt.

units.zh: 先儒難「月以望蝕，去日極遠，誰蝕月乎？」
units.en: Earlier scholars asked: "The moon is eclipsed at full moon, when it is farthest from the sun—what could eclipse it?"
units.literal: Earlier scholars objected: "The moon is eclipsed at full moon, extremely far from the sun—who eclipses the moon?"

units.zh: 說者稱「日有暗氣，天有虛道，常與日衡相對，月行在虛道中，則爲氣所弇，故月爲蝕也。
units.en: Defenders answered: "The sun casts a dark vapor, and heaven has a void track always opposite the solar axis. When the moon passes through that track, the vapor covers it, and the moon is eclipsed.
units.literal: Respondents said: "The sun has dark qi; heaven has a void path constantly opposite the sun's axis; when the moon travels in the void path it is blotted by qi—thus the moon is eclipsed.

units.zh: 雖時加夜半，日月當子午，正隔於地，猶爲暗氣所蝕，以天體大而地形小故也。
units.en: Even at midnight, when sun and moon stand at south and north and the earth lies directly between them, the dark vapor can still eclipse the moon, because the heavens are vast and the earth small.
units.literal: Even when timed at midnight, sun and moon at south and north zenith directly separated by earth, still eclipsed by dark qi—because the heavenly body is large and the terrestrial form small.

units.zh: 暗虛之氣，如以鏡在日下，其光耀魄，乃見於陰中，常與日衡相對，故當星星亡，當月月蝕」。
units.en: That dark void is like a mirror held beneath the sun: its reflected light shows in the shadow and always faces the solar axis. Hence when a star crosses it the star disappears, and when the moon crosses it the moon is eclipsed."
units.literal: The dark void qi is like holding a mirror under the sun—its light shines the brightness and is seen in shadow, constantly opposite the sun's axis—hence when a star [passes it] the star vanishes, when the moon [passes it] the moon is eclipsed."

units.zh: 今問之曰：「星月同體，俱兆日耀，當月之蝕，星不必亡。
units.en: One may still ask: "Stars and moon alike reflect the sun's light—when the moon is eclipsed, why need stars not vanish too?
units.literal: Now one asks: "Stars and moon are the same kind of body, both reflecting solar glory—when the moon is eclipsed, stars need not vanish.

units.zh: 若更有所當，星未嘗蝕，同稟異虧，其故何也？」
units.en: If something else were blocking the path, stars are never eclipsed; they share the same light yet suffer differently—why?"
units.literal: If there were another [body] it encountered, stars are never eclipsed—same endowment but different waning—why is this?"

units.zh: 荅曰：「月爲陰主，以當陽位，體敵勢交，自招盈損。
units.en: The reply: "The moon is yin's sovereign standing in yang's place; matched in body and crossed in force, it naturally waxes and wanes.
units.literal: Answer: "The moon is mistress of yin, standing in the yang position—bodies matched, forces in interplay, it naturally invites waxing and waning.

units.zh: 星雖同類，而精景陋狹，小毀皆亡，無有受蝕之地，纖光可滿，亦不與弦望同形。」
units.en: Stars, though akin, have small and narrow bodies and light; the least harm extinguishes them, and they have no place to be eclipsed. Their thin light can fill the void, and they do not share the moon's crescent and full shapes."
units.literal: Stars though of the same kind have narrow, cramped essences and light—slight damage and all vanish, with no ground to receive eclipse; their slender light can fill [the void], nor do they share the crescent and full forms."

units.zh: 又難曰：「日之夜蝕，驗於夜星之亡，晝蝕旣盡，晝星何故反不見？」
units.en: Another objection was raised: "Night solar eclipses are confirmed when stars vanish at night—yet when a daytime eclipse is total, why do daytime stars not appear?"
units.literal: Another objection was raised: "When the sun is eclipsed at night, this is verified by the disappearance of stars at night; when a daytime eclipse is complete, why are daytime stars not seen in turn?"

units.zh: 答之曰：「夫言光有所衝，則有不衝之光矣；
units.en: The reply was: "If light sometimes strikes something, it also sometimes does not;
units.literal: The answer was: "When one says light has something it strikes against, there is also light that does not strike;

units.zh: 言有所當，亦有所不當矣。
units.en: if something is sometimes aligned, it is also sometimes not aligned.
units.literal: when one says something is aligned, there is also what is not aligned.

units.zh: 夜食度遠，與所當而同沒；
units.en: At a night eclipse the position is far off, and it sets together with what is aligned;
units.literal: At a night eclipse the degree is far, and it sets together with what is aligned;

units.zh: 晝食度近，由非衝而得明。」
units.en: at a day eclipse the position is near, and light returns because there is no direct strike."
units.literal: at a day eclipse the degree is near, and brightness comes from not striking directly."

units.zh: 又問：「太白經天，實緣遠日。
units.en: Another question: "Venus crossing the sky truly comes from standing far from the sun.
units.literal: Another question: "When Venus crosses the heavens, it is truly because it is far from the sun.

units.zh: 今度近更明，於何取喻？」
units.en: Now at a nearer position it shines even brighter—what comparison fits?"
units.literal: Now at a near degree it shines brighter—what analogy does one take?"

units.zh: 荅曰：「向論二蝕之體，周衝不同，經與不經，自由星遲疾，難蝕引經，恐未得也。」
units.en: The reply: "The two eclipse forms just discussed differ in how their circuits align; whether a star crosses the sky depends on its speed. Invoking sky-crossing to explain eclipses probably will not do."
units.literal: The answer: "The discussion just now of the two forms of eclipse differed in orbital alignment; whether one crosses the sky or not depends freely on whether the star is slow or fast. To cite crossing the sky in explaining eclipses is probably not valid."

units.zh: 日光色
units.en: Solar Color
units.literal: Color of sunlight

units.zh: 建元四年十一月午時，日色赤黃無光，至暮，在箕宿。
units.en: In the eleventh month of the fourth year of Jianyuan, at noon the sun turned reddish yellow and lost its light until evening, in the Winnowing-Basket mansion.
units.literal: Jianyuan year 4, eleventh month, at the noon hour—the sun was reddish-yellow and without brilliance until evening, in the Winnowing-Basket mansion.

units.zh: 二年閏正月乙酉，日黃赤無光，至暮。
units.en: In the intercalary first month of year 2, on yiyou, the sun was yellow-red and dim until evening.
units.literal: Second year, intercalary first month, on yiyou—the sun was yellow-red and without brilliance until evening.

units.zh: 永明五年十一月丁亥，日出高三竿，失色赤黃，日暈，虹抱珥直背。
units.en: In the eleventh month of Yongming 5, on dinghai, when the sun stood three bamboo poles above the horizon it faded red-yellow, showed a solar halo, and bore rainbow, embrace, spikes, straight streak, and counter-glow.
units.literal: Yongming year 5, eleventh month, on dinghai—at sunrise three bamboo-poles high the sun lost its color to red-yellow, showed a solar halo, with rainbow, embrace, spikes, straight streak, and counter-glow.

units.zh: 建元元年十二月未時，日暈，帀，黃白色，至申乃消散。
units.en: In the twelfth month of the first year of Jianyuan, at the wei hour the sun showed a complete yellow-white halo that cleared by the shen hour.
units.literal: the first year of Jianyuan, twelfth month, at the wei hour—a solar halo, complete ring, yellow-white, dissipated by the shen hour.

units.zh: 永明二年正月丁酉，日交暈再重。
units.en: In the first month of Yongming 2, on dingyou, the sun showed double intersecting halos.
units.literal: Yongming year 2, first month, on dingyou—double intersecting solar halos, layered twice.

units.zh: 三年二月丁卯，日有半暈，暈上生一闕。
units.en: In the second month of year 3, on dingmao, the sun bore a half-halo with a break in the ring.
units.literal: In the third year, second month, on dingmao—the sun had a half-halo, and on the halo a gap formed.

units.zh: 四年五月丙午，日暈再重，仍白虹貫日，在東井度。
units.en: In the fifth month of year 4, on bingwu, double solar halos appeared and a white arc cut across the sun in the Well mansion.
units.literal: In the fourth year, fifth month, on bingwu—double solar halos, and a white arc pierced the sun, in the Well mansion degree.

units.zh: 六年三月甲申，日於蘭雲中薄半暈，須臾過帀，日東南暈外有一直，竝黃色。
units.en: In the third month of year 6, on jiashen, the sun in orchid-tinted clouds showed a thin half-halo, then quickly a full ring; southeast outside the halo a straight yellow streak appeared.
units.literal: Year 6, third month, on jiashen—the sun amid orchid-colored clouds showed a faint half-halo; presently it passed into full ring; southeast of the halo outside the sun a straight streak, all yellow.

units.zh: 壬辰，日暈，須臾，日西北生虹貫日中。
units.en: On renchen a solar halo formed; presently a white arc from the northwest pierced the sun's center.
units.literal: On renchen—a solar halo; presently from the northwest a white arc pierced through the sun's center.

units.zh: 八年十一月己亥，日半暈，南面不帀，日東西帶暈，各生珥，長三尺，白色，珥各長十丈許，正衝日，久久消散，背因成重暈，竝青絳色。
units.en: In the eleventh month of year 8, on jihai, a half-halo left the south incomplete; east and west band-halos each grew white three-chi spikes about ten zhang long, facing the sun; after long delay all faded, and counter-glow formed double halos in blue and purple.
units.literal: Year 8, eleventh month, on jihai—half solar halo, the south side not complete; east and west band-halos each bore spikes three chi long, white; each spike about ten zhang, directly facing the sun; after long time dissipated; counter-glow then formed double halos, all bluish and purplish.

units.zh: 九年正月甲午，日半暈，南面不帀，北帶暈生一抱，東西各生一珥，抱北又有半暈，抱珥竝黃色，北又生白虹貫日，久久消散。
units.en: In the first month of year 9, on jiawu, a half-halo left the south open; the north band-halo grew an embrace, east and west each a spike, and north of the embrace another half-halo—all yellow; north again a white arc pierced the sun, then slowly cleared.
units.literal: In the ninth year, first month, on jiawu—half halo, south incomplete; on the north band-halo an embrace formed; east and west each a spike; north of the embrace another half-halo; embrace and spikes all yellow; north again a white arc pierced the sun; after long time dissipated.

units.zh: 建元元年六月甲申，日南北兩珥，西有抱，黃白色。
units.en: In the sixth month of the first year of Jianyuan, on jiashen, the sun bore two yellow-white spikes north and south and an embrace on the west.
units.literal: the first year of Jianyuan, sixth month, on jiashen—two spikes south and north on the sun, an embrace on the west, yellow-white.

units.zh: 永明二年十一月辛巳，日東北有一背。
units.en: In the eleventh month of Yongming 2, on xinsi, a counter-glow appeared northeast of the sun.
units.literal: Yongming year 2, eleventh month, on xinsi—a counter-glow northeast of the sun.

units.zh: 三年十一月庚寅，日西北有一背。
units.en: In the eleventh month of year 3, on gengyin, a counter-glow appeared northwest of the sun.
units.literal: In the third year, eleventh month, on gengyin—a counter-glow northwest of the sun.

units.zh: 四年正月辛巳，日南北各生一珥，又生一背。
units.en: In the first month of year 4, on xinsi, the sun grew a spike south and north and also a counter-glow.
units.literal: In the fourth year, first month, on xinsi—south and north each bore a spike, and a counter-glow also formed.

units.zh: 十二月辛未，日西北生一直，黃白色。
units.en: In the twelfth month, on xinwei, a yellow-white straight streak formed northwest of the sun.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on xinwei—a straight streak formed northwest of the sun, yellow-white.

units.zh: 戊寅，日北生一背，青絳色。
units.en: On wuyin a blue-purple counter-glow formed north of the sun.
units.literal: On wuyin—a counter-glow formed north of the sun, bluish-purplish.

units.zh: 五年八月己卯，日東南生一珥，竝青絳色。
units.en: In the eighth month of year 5, on jimao, a blue-purple spike formed southeast of the sun.
units.literal: Year 5, eighth month, on jimao—a spike formed southeast of the sun, also bluish-purplish.

units.zh: 六年二月丁巳，日東北生黃色，北有一珥，黃赤色，久久竝散。
units.en: In the second month of year 6, on dingsi, yellow light appeared northeast of the sun; north a yellow-red spike; after long delay all dispersed.
units.literal: Year 6, second month, on dingsi—yellow color formed northeast of the sun; north a spike, yellow-red; after long time all dispersed.

units.zh: 庚申，日西有一背，赤青色，東西生一直，南北各生一珥，竝黃白色。
units.en: On gengshen a red-blue counter-glow appeared west of the sun; east and west a straight streak; south and north each a yellow-white spike.
units.literal: On gengshen—a counter-glow west of the sun, red-bluish; east and west a straight streak; south and north each a spike—all yellow-white.

units.zh: 七年十月癸未，日東北生一背，青赤色，須臾消。
units.en: In the tenth month of year 7, on guiwei, a green-red counter-glow northeast of the sun quickly faded.
units.literal: Year 7, tenth month, on guiwei—a counter-glow northeast of the sun, green-red, dissipated presently.

units.zh: 八年六月戊寅，日於蒼白雲中南北各生一珥，青黃絳雜色，澤潤，竝長三尺許，至巳午消。
units.en: In the sixth month of year 8, on wuyin, the sun in pale clouds bore north and south spikes of mixed green, yellow, and purple, bright and about three chi long; they vanished by si and wu hours.
units.literal: In the eighth year, sixth month, on wuyin—the sun amid pale clouds bore a spike south and north, mixed green-yellow-purple, lustrous, each about three chi long; vanished by si and wu hours.

units.zh: 隆昌元年正月壬戌，日於蘭雲中暈，南北帶暈各生一直，同長一丈，須臾消。
units.en: In the first month of Longchang 1, on renxu, the sun in orchid-tinted clouds showed a halo; south and north band-halos each grew a one-zhang straight streak, then quickly cleared.
units.literal: Longchang year 1, first month, on renxu—the sun amid orchid-colored clouds showed a halo; on the south and north band-halos each a straight streak, equally one zhang long; dissipated presently.

units.zh: 永元元年十二月乙酉，日中有三黑子。
units.en: In the twelfth month of Yongyuan 1, on yiyou, three black spots appeared on the sun.
units.literal: Yongyuan year 1, twelfth month, on yiyou—three black spots in the sun.

units.zh: 月暈犯
units.en: Lunar Halos and Transits
units.literal: Lunar halo transits

units.zh: 建元四年十月庚寅，月暈五車及參頭。
units.en: In the tenth month of the fourth year of Jianyuan, on gengyin, the moon's halo ringed the Five Chariots and Cantou.
units.literal: Jianyuan year 4, tenth month, on gengyin—the moon's halo encompassed Wuche and Cantou.

units.zh: 永明元年正月壬辰，是日至十五日，月三暈太微及熒惑。
units.en: In the first month of Yongming 1, on renchen, from that day through the fifteenth the moon thrice haloed Taiwei and Mars.
units.literal: Yongming year 1, first month, on renchen—from this day to the fifteenth, the moon thrice haloed Taiwei and Yinghuo.

units.zh: 三月庚申至十三日，月三暈太微及熒惑。
units.en: In the third month, from gengshen through the thirteenth, the moon thrice haloed Taiwei and Mars.
units.literal: Third month, from gengshen to the thirteenth, the moon thrice haloed Taiwei and Yinghuo.

units.zh: 五年二月乙未，自九日至是日，月三暈太微。
units.en: In the second month of year 5, on yiwei, from the ninth through that day the moon thrice haloed Taiwei.
units.literal: Year 5, second month, on yiwei—from the ninth to this day, the moon thrice haloed Taiwei.

units.zh: 六年二月壬戌甲夜、十三日甲夜、十五日甲夜，月竝暈太微。
units.en: In the second month of year 6, on the renxu jia watch, the thirteenth jia watch, and the fifteenth jia watch, the moon each time haloed Taiwei.
units.literal: Year 6, second month—on nights of renxu-jia, the thirteenth jia night, and the fifteenth jia night, the moon all showed halos encompassing Taiwei.

units.zh: 永明元年十一月己未，月南北各生一珥，又有一抱。
units.en: In the eleventh month of Yongming 1, on jiwei, the moon grew spikes south and north and also an embrace.
units.literal: Yongming the first year, eleventh month, on jiwei—the moon bore a spike south and north, and also an embrace.

units.zh: 月犯列星
units.en: Lunar Transits of Individual Stars
units.literal: Lunar transits of listed stars

units.zh: 建元元年七月丁未，月犯心大星北一寸。
units.en: In the seventh month of the first year of Jianyuan, on dingwei, the moon transited the great star of Heart one cun to the north.
units.literal: the first year of Jianyuan, seventh month, on dingwei—the moon transited the great star of Heart, one cun north.

units.zh: 丁卯，月入軒轅中犯第二星。
units.en: On dingmao the moon entered Xuanyuan and transited the second star.
units.literal: On dingmao—the moon entered Xuanyuan and transited the second star.

units.zh: 十月丙申，月在心大星西北七寸。
units.en: In the tenth month, on bingshen, the moon stood seven cun northwest of the great star of Heart.
units.literal: Tenth month, on bingshen—the moon was northwest of the great star of Heart by seven cun.

units.zh: 十一月壬戌，月在氐東南星五寸。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on renxu, the moon stood five cun from Di's southeastern star.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on renxu—the moon was five cun from Di's southeastern star.

units.zh: 十二月乙酉，月犯太微西蕃南頭第一星。
units.en: In the twelfth month, on yiyou, the moon transited the first star at the south end of Taiwei's western rampart.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on yiyou—the moon transited the first star at the southern end of Taiwei's western rampart.

units.zh: 庚寅，月行房道中，無所犯。
units.en: On gengyin the moon passed along the Road of Room without transiting any star.
units.literal: On gengyin—the moon traveled in the Road of Room, transiting nothing.

units.zh: 癸巳，月入南斗魁中，無所犯。
units.en: On guisi the moon entered the Southern Dipper's leading stars without transiting any star.
units.literal: On guisi—the moon entered the Dipper's Leading stars, transiting nothing.

units.zh: 二年三月癸卯，月犯心大星，又犯後星。
units.en: In the third month of year 2, on guimao, the moon transited the great star of Heart and also the rear star.
units.literal: Year 2, third month, on guimao—the moon transited the great star of Heart and also the rear star.

units.zh: 五月庚戌，月入南斗。
units.en: In the fifth month, on gengxu, the moon entered the Southern Dipper.
units.literal: Fifth month, on gengxu—the moon entered the Southern Dipper.

units.zh: 七月己巳，月入南斗。
units.en: Seventh month, on jisi, the moon entered the Southern Dipper.
units.literal: Seventh month, on jisi, the moon entered the Southern Dipper.

units.zh: 三年二月癸巳，月犯太微上將。
units.en: In the third year, second month, on guisi, the moon encroached upon the supreme general of the Supreme Palace.
units.literal: In the third year, second month, on guisi, the moon encroached upon the supreme general of the Supreme Palace.

units.zh: 四年二月乙亥，月犯輿鬼西北星。
units.en: In the fourth year, second month, on yihai, the moon encroached upon Ghost's northwest star.
units.literal: In the fourth year, second month, on yihai, the moon encroached upon the northwestern star of Ghost.

units.zh: 丙子，月犯南斗魁第二星。
units.en: On bingzi the moon encroached upon the second star of the Southern Dipper's head.
units.literal: On bingzi, the moon encroached upon the second star of the Southern Dipper's head.

units.zh: 辛未，月犯心大星，又犯後星。
units.en: On xinwei the moon encroached upon Heart's great star and its rear star.
units.literal: On xinwei, the moon encroached upon the great star of Heart, also encroaching upon the rear star.

units.zh: 四月壬辰，月犯軒轅左民星。
units.en: Fourth month, on renchen, the moon encroached upon Xuanyuan's left commoners star.
units.literal: Fourth month, on renchen, the moon encroached upon the left commoners star of Xuanyuan.

units.zh: 庚子，月犯箕東北星。
units.en: On gengzi the moon encroached upon Winnowing Basket's northeastern star.
units.literal: On gengzi, the moon encroached upon the northeastern star of Winnowing Basket.

units.zh: 五月丙寅，月犯心後星。
units.en: Fifth month, on bingyin, the moon encroached upon Heart's rear star.
units.literal: Fifth month, on bingyin, the moon encroached upon the rear star of Heart.

units.zh: 戊寅，月掩昴西北星。
units.en: On wuyin the moon occulted Hairy Head's northwest star.
units.literal: On wuyin, the moon occulted the northwestern star of Hairy Head.

units.zh: 六月乙未，月犯箕東北星。
units.en: Sixth month, on yiwei, the moon encroached upon Winnowing Basket's northeastern star.
units.literal: Sixth month, on yiwei, the moon encroached upon the northeastern star of Winnowing Basket.

units.zh: 七月癸亥，月行南斗魁中，無所犯。
units.en: Seventh month, on guihai, the moon passed through the Southern Dipper's head without encroaching.
units.literal: Seventh month, on guihai, the moon passed through the head of the Southern Dipper without encroaching.

units.zh: 庚辰，月犯軒轅女主。
units.en: On gengchen the moon encroached upon Xuanyuan's lady master.
units.literal: On gengchen, the moon encroached upon the lady master of Xuanyuan.

units.zh: 八月庚子，月犯昴西南星。
units.en: Eighth month, on gengzi, the moon encroached upon Hairy Head's southwest star.
units.literal: Eighth month, on gengzi, the moon encroached upon the southwestern star of Hairy Head.

units.zh: 壬寅，月犯五車東南星。
units.en: On renyin the moon encroached upon Five Chariots' southeast star.
units.literal: On renyin, the moon encroached upon the southeastern star of Five Chariots.

units.zh: 壬申，月犯軒轅少民星。
units.en: On renshen the moon encroached upon Xuanyuan's lesser commoners star.
units.literal: On renshen, the moon encroached upon the lesser commoners star of Xuanyuan.

units.zh: 九月丁巳，月犯箕東北星。
units.en: Ninth month, on dingsi, the moon encroached upon Winnowing Basket's northeastern star.
units.literal: Ninth month, on dingsi, the moon encroached upon the northeastern star of Winnowing Basket.

units.zh: 壬辰，月在營室度，入羽林中。
units.en: On renchen the moon stood at the Encampment degree and entered the Feathered Forest.
units.literal: On renchen, the moon was at the Encampment degree, entering the Feathered Forest.

units.zh: 二十日，月入輿鬼，犯積尸。
units.en: On the twentieth day the moon entered Ghost and encroached upon Accumulated Corpses.
units.literal: On the twentieth day, the moon entered Ghost, encroaching upon Accumulated Corpses.

units.zh: 十一月甲戌，月犯五車南星。
units.en: Eleventh month, on jiaxu, the moon encroached upon Five Chariots' south star.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on jiaxu, the moon encroached upon the southern star of Five Chariots.

units.zh: 十二月丁酉，月犯軒轅女主星，又掩女御。
units.en: Twelfth month, on dingyou, the moon encroached upon Xuanyuan's lady master and occulted the lady attendant.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on dingyou, the moon encroached upon the lady master star of Xuanyuan, also occulting the lady attendant.

units.zh: 永元元年正月己亥，月犯心後星。
units.en: Yongyuan 1, first month, on jihai, the moon encroached upon Heart's rear star.
units.literal: Yongyuan year 1, first month, on jihai, the moon encroached upon the rear star of Heart.

units.zh: 三月乙未，月犯軒轅女主星。
units.en: Third month, on yiwei, the moon encroached upon Xuanyuan's lady master star.
units.literal: Third month, on yiwei, the moon encroached upon the lady master star of Xuanyuan.

units.zh: 六月癸酉，月犯輿鬼西南星。
units.en: Sixth month, on guiyou, the moon encroached upon Ghost's southwest star.
units.literal: Sixth month, on guiyou, the moon encroached upon the southwestern star of Ghost.

units.zh: 八月乙丑，月犯南斗第四星，又犯輿鬼星。
units.en: Eighth month, on yichou, the moon encroached upon the Southern Dipper's fourth star and a star of Ghost.
units.literal: Eighth month, on yichou, the moon encroached upon the fourth star of the Southern Dipper, also encroaching upon a star of Ghost.

units.zh: 九月庚辰，月犯太白左蕃度。
units.en: Ninth month, on gengchen, the moon encroached upon Venus's left battlement degree.
units.literal: Ninth month, on gengchen, the moon encroached upon the left battlement degree of the Great White Star.

units.zh: 癸巳，月犯東井北轅西頭第一星。
units.en: On guisi the moon encroached upon the first star at the western end of the Eastern Well's northern crossbar.
units.literal: On guisi, the moon encroached upon the first star at the western head of the northern crossbar of the Eastern Well.

units.zh: 十二月丁卯，月犯心前星，又犯大星。
units.en: Twelfth month, on dingmao, the moon encroached upon Heart's fore star and its great star.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on dingmao, the moon encroached upon the fore star of Heart, also encroaching upon the great star.

units.zh: 己巳，月犯南斗第五星。
units.en: On jisi the moon encroached upon the fifth star of the Southern Dipper.
units.literal: On jisi, the moon encroached upon the fifth star of the Southern Dipper.

units.zh: 二年二月甲子，月犯南斗第四星，又犯第三星。
units.en: In the second year, second month, on jiazi, the moon encroached upon the Southern Dipper's fourth and third stars.
units.literal: In the second year, second month, on jiazi, the moon encroached upon the fourth star of the Southern Dipper, also encroaching upon the third star.

units.zh: 三月丁丑，月犯東井北轅北頭第一星。
units.en: Third month, on dingchou, the moon encroached upon the first star at the northern end of the Eastern Well's northern crossbar.
units.literal: Third month, on dingchou, the moon encroached upon the first star at the northern head of the northern crossbar of the Eastern Well.

units.zh: 四月戊申，月犯軒轅右角。
units.en: Fourth month, on wushen, the moon encroached upon Xuanyuan's right horn.
units.literal: Fourth month, on wushen, the moon encroached upon the right horn of Xuanyuan.

units.zh: 六月丙寅，月犯東井轅頭第一星。
units.en: Sixth month, on bingyin, the moon encroached upon the first star at the head of the Eastern Well crossbar.
units.literal: Sixth month, on bingyin, the moon encroached upon the first star at the head of the Eastern Well crossbar.

units.zh: 八月丙午，月掩心大星。
units.en: Eighth month, on bingwu, the moon occulted Heart's great star.
units.literal: Eighth month, on bingwu, the moon occulted the great star of Heart.

units.zh: 戊申，月犯南斗第三星。
units.en: On wushen the moon encroached upon the third star of the Southern Dipper.
units.literal: On wushen, the moon encroached upon the third star of the Southern Dipper.

units.zh: 戊子，月犯東井北轅西頭第一星。
units.en: On wuzi the moon encroached upon the first star at the western end of the Eastern Well's northern crossbar.
units.literal: On wuzi, the moon encroached upon the first star at the western head of the northern crossbar of the Eastern Well.

units.zh: 十一月庚辰，月犯昴星。
units.en: Eleventh month, on gengchen, the moon encroached upon a star of Hairy Head.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on gengchen, the moon encroached upon a star of Hairy Head.

units.zh: 丙戌，月犯軒轅左角。
units.en: On bingxu the moon encroached upon Xuanyuan's left horn.
units.literal: On bingxu, the moon encroached upon the left horn of Xuanyuan.

units.zh: 十二月壬戌，月犯心前星，又犯大星。
units.en: Twelfth month, on renxu, the moon encroached upon Heart's fore star and its great star.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on renxu, the moon encroached upon the fore star of Heart, also encroaching upon the great star.

units.zh: 三年二月己未，月犯南斗第五星。
units.en: In the third year, second month, on jiwei, the moon encroached upon the fifth star of the Southern Dipper.
units.literal: In the third year, second month, on jiwei, the moon encroached upon the fifth star of the Southern Dipper.

units.zh: 三月壬申，月在東井，無所犯。
units.en: Third month, on renshen, the moon stood in the Eastern Well without encroaching.
units.literal: Third month, on renshen, the moon was in the Eastern Well without encroaching.

units.zh: 六月丙午，月掩心前星。
units.en: Sixth month, on bingwu, the moon occulted Heart's fore star.
units.literal: Sixth month, on bingwu, the moon occulted the fore star of Heart.

units.zh: 八月丙辰，月犯東井北轅第二星。
units.en: Eighth month, on bingchen, the moon encroached upon the second star of the Eastern Well's northern crossbar.
units.literal: Eighth month, on bingchen, the moon encroached upon the second star of the northern crossbar of the Eastern Well.

units.zh: 九月癸未，月犯東井南轅西頭第一星。
units.en: Ninth month, on guiwei, the moon encroached upon the first star at the western end of the Eastern Well's southern crossbar.
units.literal: Ninth month, on guiwei, the moon encroached upon the first star at the western head of the southern crossbar of the Eastern Well.

units.zh: 四年正月癸酉，月入東井，無所犯。
units.en: In the fourth year, first month, on guiyou, the moon entered the Eastern Well without encroaching.
units.literal: In the fourth year, first month, on guiyou, the moon entered the Eastern Well without encroaching.

units.zh: 乙亥，月犯輿鬼。
units.en: On yihai the moon encroached upon Ghost.
units.literal: On yihai, the moon encroached upon Ghost.

units.zh: 閏月辛亥，月犯房。
units.en: In the intercalary month, on xinhai, the moon encroached upon Room.
units.literal: Intercalary month, on xinhai, the moon encroached upon Room.

units.zh: 二月丁卯，月犯東井鉞。
units.en: Second month, on dingmao, the moon encroached upon the Eastern Well halberd.
units.literal: Second month, on dingmao, the moon encroached upon the halberd of the Eastern Well.

units.zh: 三月乙未，月入東井，無所犯。
units.en: Third month, on yiwei, the moon entered the Eastern Well without encroaching.
units.literal: Third month, on yiwei, the moon entered the Eastern Well without encroaching.

units.zh: 七月辛亥，月犯東井。
units.en: Seventh month, on xinhai, the moon encroached upon the Eastern Well.
units.literal: Seventh month, on xinhai, the moon encroached upon the Eastern Well.

units.zh: 八月戊寅，月犯東井。
units.en: Eighth month, on wuyin, the moon encroached upon the Eastern Well.
units.literal: Eighth month, on wuyin, the moon encroached upon the Eastern Well.

units.zh: 九月辛卯，月與太白於尾合宿。
units.en: Ninth month, on xinmao, the moon and Venus met at Tail.
units.literal: Ninth month, on xinmao, the moon and the Great White Star conjoined at Tail.

units.zh: 丙午，月入東井。
units.en: On bingwu the moon entered the Eastern Well.
units.literal: On bingwu, the moon entered the Eastern Well.

units.zh: 十一月辛丑，月入東井曠中。
units.en: Eleventh month, on xinchou, the moon entered the Eastern Well's open field.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on xinchou, the moon entered the open field of the Eastern Well.

units.zh: 辛亥，月犯房北頭第二星。
units.en: On xinhai the moon encroached upon the second star at Room's northern head.
units.literal: On xinhai, the moon encroached upon the second star at the northern head of Room.

units.zh: 十二月己巳，月犯東井北轅東頭第二星。
units.en: Twelfth month, on jisi, the moon encroached upon the second star at the east end of the Eastern Well's northern crossbar.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on jisi, the moon encroached upon the second star at the eastern end of the Eastern Well's northern crossbar.

units.zh: 辛巳，月犯南斗第六星。
units.en: On xinsi the moon encroached upon the sixth star of the Southern Dipper.
units.literal: On xinsi, the moon encroached upon the sixth star of the Southern Dipper.

units.zh: 五年正月丙午，月犯房鉤鈐。
units.en: In the fifth year, first month, on bingwu, the moon encroached upon Room's Hook and Sickle.
units.literal: In the fifth year, first month, on bingwu, the moon encroached upon Room's Hook and Sickle.

units.zh: 二月癸亥，月犯東井南轅西頭第二星。
units.en: Second month, on guihai, the moon encroached upon the second star at the west end of the Eastern Well's southern crossbar.
units.literal: Second month, on guihai, the moon encroached upon the second star at the western end of the Eastern Well's southern crossbar.

units.zh: 三月癸卯，月犯南斗第二星。
units.en: Third month, on guimao, the moon encroached upon the second star of the Southern Dipper.
units.literal: Third month, on guimao, the moon encroached upon the second star of the Southern Dipper.

units.zh: 六月乙丑，月犯南斗第六星，在南斗七寸。
units.en: Sixth month, on yichou, the moon encroached upon the Southern Dipper's sixth star, seven cun inside the asterism.
units.literal: Sixth month, on yichou, the moon encroached upon the sixth star of the Southern Dipper, seven cun within the Southern Dipper.

units.zh: 丙寅，月犯西建星北一尺。
units.en: On bingyin the moon encroached one chi north of the Western Establishment Star.
units.literal: On bingyin, the moon encroached one chi north of the Western Establishment Star.

units.zh: 史臣曰：《月令》昏明中星，皆二十八宿。
units.en: The compiler remarks: The Monthly Ordinances place the dusk-and-dawn mid-stars among the twenty-eight lodges.
units.literal: The historians say: In the Monthly Ordinances, the mid-stars of dusk and dawn are all among the twenty-eight lodges.

units.zh: 箕斗之閒，微爲疏闊。
units.en: Between Winnowing Basket and the Dipper the spacing runs somewhat wide.
units.literal: Between Winnowing Basket and the Dipper the spacing is somewhat wide.

units.zh: 故仲春之與孟秋，建星再用，與宿度竝列，亟經陵犯，災之所主，未有舊占。
units.en: Hence at mid-spring and early autumn Establishment Star is invoked a second time, set alongside lodge degrees; it suffers encroachments again and again—yet what calamity it governs has no received interpretation.
units.literal: Hence at mid-spring and early autumn Establishment Star is used twice, standing alongside lodge degrees; it is repeatedly encroached upon, yet what disaster it governs has no established omen.

units.zh: 《石氏星經》云：「斗主爵祿，褒賢進士，故置建星以爲輔。
units.en: The Shi clan Star Classic says: "The Dipper presides over rank and emolument, honoring the worthy and advancing scholars—hence Establishment Star is planted as its aide.
units.literal: The Shi clan Star Classic says: "The Dipper governs rank and salary, honors the worthy and advances scholars—hence Establishment Star is set as its aide.

units.zh: 若犯建之異，不與斗同。」
units.en: An anomaly of encroaching Establishment is not the same as one of the Dipper—"
units.literal: If an anomaly of encroaching Establishment differs from that of the Dipper itself—"

units.zh: 則據文求義，亦宰相之占也。
units.en: —reading the text for its import, this too is an omen for the chancellor.
units.literal: —then reading the text for its meaning, it is also an omen for the chancellor.

units.zh: 七月丁未，月行入東井曠中，無所犯。
units.en: Seventh month, on dingwei, the moon passed into the Eastern Well's open field without encroaching on any star.
units.literal: Seventh month, on dingwei, the moon traveled into the open field of the Eastern Well without encroaching upon anything.

units.zh: 八月壬申，月在畢，犯左股第二星西北三寸。
units.en: Eighth month, on renshen, the moon stood in the Net and encroached three cun northwest of the second star of the left thigh.
units.literal: Eighth month, on renshen, the moon was in the Net, encroaching upon the northwest of the second star of the left thigh by three cun.

units.zh: 九月戊子，月在填星北二尺八寸，爲合宿。
units.en: Ninth month, on wuzi, the moon stood two chi eight cun north of Saturn in conjoined lodging.
units.literal: Ninth month, on wuzi, the moon stood two chi eight cun north of Saturn, forming a conjoined lodging.

units.zh: 十月戊寅，月入氐犯東南星西北一尺餘。
units.en: Tenth month, on wuyin, the moon entered Di and encroached a little over one chi northwest of the southeastern star.
units.literal: Tenth month, on wuyin, the moon entered Di and encroached upon the northwest of the southeastern star by a little over one chi.

units.zh: 十一月戊寅，月入氐。
units.en: Eleventh month, on wuyin, the moon entered Di.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on wuyin, the moon entered Di.

units.zh: 十二月戊午，月在東壁度，在熒惑北，相去二尺七寸，爲合宿。
units.en: Twelfth month, on wuwu, the moon stood at the Eastern Wall degree, two chi seven cun north of Mars in conjoined lodging.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on wuwu, the moon stood at the Eastern Wall degree, two chi seven cun north of Mars, forming a conjoined lodging.

units.zh: 甲子，月在東壁度東南九寸，爲犯。
units.en: On jiazi the moon at the Eastern Wall degree encroached nine cun southeast.
units.literal: On jiazi, the moon at the Eastern Wall degree encroached nine cun to the southeast.

units.zh: 癸酉，月在歲星南七寸，爲犯。
units.en: On guiyou the moon stood seven cun south of Jupiter—an encroachment.
units.literal: On guiyou, the moon stood seven cun south of Jupiter, counted as encroachment.

units.zh: 六年正月戊戌，月在角星南，相去三寸。
units.en: In the sixth year, first month, on wuxu, the moon stood three cun south of the Horn star.
units.literal: In the sixth year, first month, on wuxu, the moon stood south of the Horn star, three cun apart.

units.zh: 二月丁卯，月在氐西南六寸。
units.en: Second month, on dingmao, the moon stood six cun southwest of Di.
units.literal: Second month, on dingmao, the moon stood six cun southwest of Di.

units.zh: 三月乙未，月入氐中，在歲星南一尺一寸，爲合宿。
units.en: Third month, on yiwei, the moon entered Di, one chi one cun south of Jupiter in conjoined lodging.
units.literal: Third month, on yiwei, the moon entered within Di, one chi one cun south of Jupiter, forming a conjoined lodging.

units.zh: 四月癸丑，月犯東井南轅西頭第二星。
units.en: Fourth month, on guichou, the moon encroached upon the second star at the west end of the Eastern Well's southern crossbar.
units.literal: Fourth month, on guichou, the moon encroached upon the second star at the western end of the Eastern Well's southern crossbar.

units.zh: 壬戌，月在氐西南星東南五寸，爲犯。
units.en: On renxu the moon stood five cun southeast of Di's southwest star—an encroachment.
units.literal: On renxu, the moon stood five cun southeast of Di's southwestern star, counted as encroachment.

units.zh: 漸入氐中，與歲星同在氐度，爲合宿。
units.en: It gradually entered Di and shared the Di degree with Jupiter in conjoined lodging.
units.literal: Gradually entering within Di, it shared the Di degree with Jupiter, forming a conjoined lodging.

units.zh: 癸亥，月行在房北頭第一星西南一尺，爲犯。
units.en: On guihai the moon passed one chi southwest of the first star at Room's northern head—an encroachment.
units.literal: On guihai, the moon traveled one chi southwest of the first star at the northern head of Room, counted as encroachment.

units.zh: 六月乙卯，月在角星東一寸，爲犯。
units.en: Sixth month, on yimao, the moon stood one cun east of the Horn star—an encroachment.
units.literal: Sixth month, on yimao, the moon stood one cun east of the Horn star, counted as encroachment.

units.zh: 丁巳，月行入氐，無所犯。
units.en: On dingsi the moon passed into Di without encroaching on any star.
units.literal: On dingsi, the moon traveled into Di without encroaching upon anything.

units.zh: 在歲星東三寸，爲合宿。
units.en: Three cun east of Jupiter in conjoined lodging.
units.literal: Three cun east of Jupiter, forming a conjoined lodging.

units.zh: 七月乙酉，月入房北頭第二次相星西北八寸，爲犯。
units.en: Seventh month, on yiyou, the moon entered eight cun northwest of the second minister star at Room's northern head—an encroachment.
units.literal: Seventh month, on yiyou, the moon entered eight cun northwest of the second minister star at the northern head of Room, counted as encroachment.

units.zh: 庚寅，月在牽牛中星南二寸，爲犯。
units.en: On gengyin the moon stood two cun south of Ox-Driver's central star—an encroachment.
units.literal: On gengyin, the moon stood two cun south of Ox-Driver's central star, counted as encroachment.

units.zh: 庚子，月行在畢左股第一星七寸，爲犯。
units.en: On gengzi the moon passed seven cun from the first star of the Net's left thigh—an encroachment.
units.literal: On gengzi, the moon traveled seven cun from the first star of the Net's left thigh, counted as encroachment.

units.zh: 又進入畢。
units.en: It also entered the Net.
units.literal: It also entered the Net.

units.zh: 八月壬子，月行在歲星東二尺五寸，同在氐中，爲合宿。
units.en: Eighth month, on renzi, the moon passed two chi five cun east of Jupiter, both within Di in conjoined lodging.
units.literal: Eighth month, on renzi, the moon traveled two chi five cun east of Jupiter, both within Di, forming a conjoined lodging.

units.zh: 九月庚辰，月在房北頭第一上相星東北一尺，爲犯。
units.en: Ninth month, on gengchen, the moon stood one chi northeast of the first upper prime minister star at Room's northern head—an encroachment.
units.literal: Ninth month, on gengchen, the moon stood one chi northeast of the first upper prime minister star at the northern head of Room, counted as encroachment.

units.zh: 又掩犯關楗閉星。
units.en: It also occulted and encroached upon the Gate Bolt and Closer star.
units.literal: It also occulted and encroached upon the Gate Bolt and Closer star.

units.zh: 丁酉，月行入東井。
